u0: Initial state: the agent has not yet killed a zombie, and no zombie has breached on the top or a side lane. The active objective is to secure the first kill by moving onto a zombie before any breach occurs; a zombie_killed step advances to u1, while a top_breach or side_breach on a step without a kill moves to failure state u2.
u1: Final success state: the agent killed a zombie before any zombie got through, satisfying the task condition. This state is absorbing; no further breach or kill transitions are tracked, and the agent may continue guarding or killing zombies only as optional play.
u2: Absorbing failure state: a zombie got through the top lane or either side lane before the agent had killed any zombie. The condition has failed irrecoverably, and no later kill can exit this state.
